meta.title: MinCirklen — Anonymous, moderated peer-support circles
meta.description: MinCirklen is an anonymous, AI-moderated peer-support platform. No profiles, no directory, no way to look anyone up — just small, moderated circles to be heard in.

hero.imageAlt: Illustration of people in a MinCirklen peer-support circle, talking anonymously and at ease
hero.title: A space to be heard, without judgment
hero.lead: Anonymous, moderated peer-support circles. We're brand new — join one of our first circles and help shape what this becomes.

stats.zeroLabel: Profiles, directories, or ways to look someone up

features.title: Built around safety
features.lead: Every part of the experience is designed to protect you first.
features.moderatedBody: A trained facilitator is present in every session, and you can leave or report at any time.
features.anonymousBody: Share as much or as little as you want — nobody sees your real name unless you choose to share it.
features.noPressureBody: Listen-only is always welcome. There's no obligation to speak, and no advice-giving unless it's asked for.

testimonial.title: Why we're building this
testimonial.quote: Make a safe and cosy place on the internet where people can finally open up. That's the whole idea — we're just getting started, and we'd rather grow slowly and safely than fast and reckless.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.lead: We're in early pilot and haven't set pricing yet — there will always be a free way in.
pricing.supportFeature1: A way to help fund hosting and safety review
pricing.supportFeature2: Same turn length and typing time as free
pricing.supportFeature3: We'll announce details before anything changes

cta.title: Ready to join a circle?
cta.body: It only takes a minute, and you can stay anonymous the whole way.
